title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

title: Ondu Sarala Prema Kathe
desc: Athishay, an aspiring music director, gets married to Anu despite their contrasting partner preferences. Later, they continue the pursuit of their soulmates.

title: Hejjaru
desc: A man haunted by a thirty-year-old cold case discovers a young stranger suffering the exact same tragedy, leading him to follow the youth into a rabbit hole.

title: Chennamma IPS
desc: When an honest police officer, Chennamma, learns about Appanna, a gangster, and his cruel son's tyranny, she decides to kill them and eliminate all the anti-social elements of society.

title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
